question: Decathlon, which set up its first outlet in India in Bengaluru in 2009, is a ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**French sports goods retailer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Decathlon** is a **French multinational sports goods retailer** known for providing high-quality products at affordable prices.
 
• It was founded in **1976** by **Michel Leclercq** in **Lille, France**. Since then, it has expanded to over **60 countries** worldwide, including **India**.
 
• Decathlon entered the Indian market in **2009**, setting up its first outlet in **Bengaluru**. It has since expanded its presence with outlets across major cities.
 
• The company specializes in **designing, manufacturing, and retailing** sports equipment and apparel for over **80 sports**, ranging from cycling, running, swimming, and hiking to niche sports like archery and horse riding.
 
• Decathlon emphasizes a **unique business model**, combining **in-house product development** with direct-to-consumer sales to reduce costs and ensure quality.
